tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rten bzhengs rnams kyi zhal byang dang bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa'i sbrang rtsi'i yol go zhes bya ba bzhugs// bgrang yas dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo dang*// dbyer med rnam rtsen gdul bya sku bzhi'i gnas// smin mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' ngag gi dbang*// kunaṃ dgaṃ' bloṃ groṃs sangaṃs rgyasaṃ baṃstan pa'i dpaṃl// gang gi zhal skyin ston pa gnas brtan dang*// bla ma yi dam lha yi bskor ba gang*// chos 'byor gyis bzhengs dge bas rgyal ba'i sku// mthong na mi mthun med rgyur yongs su bsngo// de thob bar gyi yang 'byung dal 'byor rten// skye ba dam pa'i chos dang chos smra mchog /rjes gzung lung rtogs yon tan gyis 'byor zhing*// byang chub spyod pa gegs med mthar phyin shog /ces pa bris sku'i bsngo byang 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/ shī la rat+nas smras pa'o// ༈ //rgyal gsung snying po sdom gsum zil mngar gyi// dga' ston mi zad rnam grol gsos 'gyed pa'i// skyabs mchog riṃn chenaṃ miṃ 'aṃgyur rgyal maṃtshan par// sngon rabs skye ba'i phreng ba 'dod lhar bcas// dad can slob bu chos 'byor can gyis bzhengs// dge tshogs 'dzam bu rkang 'thung mañja rī// byang chub spyod pa'i lag 'gro'i grong ltung ba// sangs rgyas gzugs sku'i gser du smin phyir bsngo// de srid skye bar dge lam sgrub pa'i rten// dal 'byor chos ldan bla ma lhag pa'i lha// 'bral med snying gi nor bu rtag bzung nas// chos mig dri bral thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa'i skye phreng bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul rin gyis smras so// ༈ //sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam mthus// 'gro ba 'dul phyir sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i grangs// kun gzod rdul phran dag byed phung po'i thigs// gaṅgā'i bye snyed ji bzhin bgrang yas kyang*// rgyal ba gnyis pa thabs shes yi ge'i dbyangs// sa gsum ldir ba'i lugs bzang riṃn cheṃn nyid// skye dgu'i bsod nams miṃ 'aṃgyur rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn rtser// 'tsho gzhes mkhas pa'i phrin las skyong mchog gi

/sngon rabs skye ba rin chen rnam bdun grangs// dus gsum gzigs pas mi 'gyur bsdebs pa'i 'phrin// dbyings nas bsgrags pa ngur smrig rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn 'chang*// byams chen sras kyi thos pa 'dzin du bsnyad// gang de rnam bkra'i ri mor shar ba'i gzugs// brgya byin tshon ris gzhon nu'i tshul mtshungs kyang*// mthong don snying pos lci ba'i khyad par can// slob 'bangs shes rab chos dbang can gyis bzhengs// 'dis mtshon dge bas 'di nas rnam mkhyen bar// dal 'byor rten ldan bla mas rjes su gzung*// chos rab 'byed pa'i shes rab snang ba yis// lung rtogs bstan pa'i phrin las dbang 'byor shog /ces mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa'i sngon rabs skye phreng dang bcas pa'i gzugs bkod kyi phyi mo zhal byang du bcas pa 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su byas pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //ngaṃg dbaṃng gzhon nu brtse chen kunaṃ dgaṃ'i srol// legs bzung smra ba mkhas pa'i rnam rol gyis// rgyal bstan phan bde'i 'byungaṃ gaṃnas 'jig rten 'dir// brtan byed chos kyi nyi ma de rmad byung*// dge mtshan tshangs pas sprul snyam gang gi sku// skyabs su bsten tsam 'khor ba ngan 'gro'i 'jigs// skyob par nges pa mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag /tshul khrims dris bsgos rang nyid kyis btab rgya// de dbus rgyal ba rgyal sras bgegs kyi dgra// rang rang dga' mar bcas pa'i gdan gsum lha// kun 'dus bdag nyid skyabs mchog rdo rje 'chang*// ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas sku// gzhan yang pad+ma 'byung dang sa skya pa// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhabs// bkra shis dbang phyug bud+dha sā ga ra// de dag rjes su slob pa'i gzugs brnyan bcas// dad gsum zhing sar byang chub sa bon bzang*// btab don bsgom bzlas lam gyi myu gu'i phreng*// bskyed du bsrings phyir sdom gsum 'dzin pa'i bshes// kun dga' rgya mtshos bsod nams zhing du bzhengs// dge bas skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma dang*// 'bral med dam tshig sdom pa'i lus stobs rdzogs// rim gnyis zung 'jug yon tan gom rlabs kyis// phyag chen mchog gi rgyal sa zin par shog

/de srid skye bar dal 'byor rten gyi grur// kun dga'i sems mchog ded dpon gyis zhugs nas// gzhung lugs rgyaṃ mtshoṃ legs brgal lung rtogs kyis// yon tan nor bu'i gter la dbang 'byor shog /ces mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas pa rang nyid kyis btab pa'i phyag rjes tshad med kyi grangs dang mnyam pa la bka' drin zla bral bla ma rnams kyi sku brnyan gyis mdzes pa 'di ko rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rgya mtsho pas bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing du bskrun pa'i zhal byang bsngo ba nyung shas 'di'ang don gnyer de nyid kyi ngor/ bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //phun tshogs gdan gsum 'khor lo'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// rgyal ba'i phrin las rgyas byed ngaṃg gi dbaṃng*// kunaṃ dgaṃ' leṃgs 'byungaṃ grags pa'i zla snang can// mdzad pa tha ma'i skur bgos ras kyi gzhir// bla ma dgyes rdor gyis mtshon lhag pa'i lha// bstan srung bcas pa'i sku brnyan dbang gzhu'i zla// shākya'i btsun pa kun dga' rgya mtsho yis// mthun rkyen legs sbyar bsod nams rten du bskrun// dge bas byang chub bar du skye nas skyer// bla ma lha dang chos srung mchog rnams kyis// 'bral med rjes gzung lung rtogs chos kun la// dbang 'byor gzugs skus 'gro don byed par shog /ces bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho pas gnas gsar zhabs drung rin po che'i pur ras la 'dod lha bris pa'i zhal byang du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //gang mtshan yi ge'i gling bu bsgyur tsam gyis// sdig ltung sbyong byed thub dbang ltung bshags kyi// sangs rgyas bskor ba'i sku brnyan phag mo yis// bzhengs pa'i dge bas sgrib byang tshogs rdzogs shog /ces bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang 'di'ang phag mo'i ngor ban+de tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //gang mtshan thos pas sdig ltung sbyong byed pa// thub dbang gtsor bzhugs sangs rgyas sum cu lnga// phag mo can gyis bzhengs pas sgrib gnyis byang*// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rgyal ba'i sku thob shog

/ces bsngo byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis so// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //ston mchog thub dbang gis mtshon rgyal ba sras// bsnyen gnas phyag mchod rten du pad bsam gyis// bskrun pa'i dge bas sgrib byang tshogs gnyis rdzogs// chos gzugs sangs rgyas sku gnyis thob par shog /ces thub dbang gtsor byas kyi bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang 'di'ang pad bsam gyi ngor bris so// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //gang sku yid kyi rtsig logs 'dri ba'am// mtshan snyan yi ge'i gling bu bsgyur bas kyang*// ngan 'gro 'khor ba'i 'jigs brgyad bcu drug las// skyob byed thugs rje sgrol ma gtso 'khor gyi// snang brnyan rlung gi rgyal mtshan ltar bkra 'di// thu ma'i srol 'dzin rnam gsal shesaṃ raṃb kyis// bden gnyis choṃs la dbangaṃ 'byor thams cad mkhyen// 'dun smon can gyis yi dam rten du bzhengs// dge tshogs skye ba 'di nas yang 'byung kun// ngan 'gro'i skye sgo yongs 'gegs dal 'byor lus// bla ma 'phags mas legs pa'i lam du bkri// zab rgyas bstan la sman 'dogs 'byung phyir bsngo// zhes drung yig shes rab chos dbang gis seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la phrin las sgrol ma nyer gcig gis bskor ba'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ ār+ya tā ra yai na maḥ gang la gsol ba btab tsam 'khor 'das kyi// 'jig tshogs kun dang bro 'tshal 'chi rigs kyi// gdung ba kun las sgrol ba'i thugs rje'i phyag /rtag tu brkyangs pa sgrol ma nyi shu gcig /sgang mgon gyis bzhengs gsol btab bsod nams mthus// rgyal sras tshul khrims rin chen lus ngag yid// ri rab gaṅgā'i 'bab rgyun rdo rje bzhin// bskal par ring 'tsho rtag brtan bsgrub mdzod cig /der brten rgyal ba'i bstan pa sems can khams// phan 'dogs mkhas pa'i phrin las rnam gsum gyi// snang ba dam pas phyogs kyi bzhin khyab pa'i// bde dgar bdag sogs gdul byas rtsen par mdzod// sbyin bdag 'khor bcas dge chos sgrub pa la// bar chad 'jigs skrag tsha gdung gang byung yang*// 'phags ma'i zhal bzang zla ba dran tsam gyis// zhi bsil bde ba'i zla 'od 'thung bar mdzod// bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// thugs rje myur ma dpa' mor rab grags pa'i// bden pas gsol btab 'bras bu g.yur za ba// mngon 'dod dbyar skyes rtse mor dud gyur cig

/ces dad can gyi a mye sgang mgon gyis kho bor ring 'tshor gsol gdab rten du sgrol ma nyer gcig sku brnyan thang kha bzhengs pa'i 'dod gsol 'di'ang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras pas sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //pra ṇi dhi sid+dhi rastu/ dngos grub zung gi gtong phod rmad byung phyag /ring du brkyangs pa dgongs 'dus lhag pa'i lha// brgya byin tshon gyis lang tsho'i mtshar sdug kyang*// phra mor byed pa'i mthong don che ba'i sku// gsang chen theg pa'i rnal 'byor lhur byed pa// pad+ma tshe dbang zhes bya'i sdom brtson pa// mi 'bral sku yi dam tshig rten gyi phyir// rgyu rkyen legs sbyar dad gsum rtsal gyis bzhengs// dge tshogs bdag gzhan sems rgyud dag pa'i gzhir// rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho gzugs rnam du// legs par 'dri la ches cher goms stobs kyi// snang srid lha yi 'khor lor 'char phyir bsngo// zhes bla ma pad+ma tshe dbang pas dgongs 'dus bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa dge'o// ༈ //sid+dhir+bha wa tu/ gzhir gnas 'khor ba'i tha mal kun rtog sgrib// sbyong byed zab gsal gnyis med lhar 'char bas// mthar thug 'bras bu'i yon tan gnas gyur du// sgrub thabs bka' brgyad lha yi 'khor lo gang*// rgyal kun 'dus zhal bla ma lhag pa'i lhas// tshe rabs kun du 'bral med rjes gzung phyir// bsgom bzlas lhur len pad+ma tshe dbang gis// rgyu rkyen phun tshogs legs sbyar nye bar bskrun// 'di bzhengs dge ba'i chu klung lam gsum pa'i// lus can sems rgyud zhing sar bran pa'i nang*// bsod nams mi dman myu gu bskyed bsring rtser// mtshan bzang rgyal sku'i snye ma g.yur za shog /ces bka' brgyad bris sku'i bsngo byang 'di ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge'o// ༈ //kun mkhyen yongs kyi gsang gsum yon tan cha// kun nas rdzogs pa chos kyi bsil sbyin gter// skyabs mchog dpal ldan chos skyong sku brnyan gyi// nam mkha'i rna ba mthong don che ba gang*// mngon 'dod bla ma lha yis yongs bskor ba// chos 'byor zhes byas phyag mchod rten bris pa'i// dge bas skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs phreng*// skyabs gsum 'bral med gtsug gis bsten par shog

/bsod nams khang bzang ngan 'gro'i skye sgo bsdam// dal rten skyes bu tshogs zung them skas brten// sa lam yon tan phun tshogs mngon bgyis nas// mtshan bzang rgyal sku'i go 'phang phyin par shog /ces pa 'di'ang chos 'byor gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //skye ba 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// ngan 'gror skye ba'i sdug kun chu gter las// sgrol byed mthu rtsal yongs rdzogs grur zhugs pa'i// gur mgon ye shes srung ma'i ded dpon cher// sog gi glang mcher grags pa'i ral gri 'dis// nyer mtshon bskang rdzas mchod sprin dngos 'byor dang*// yid byung mthun pa'i rdzas kyi mchod 'bul dag /kun dga' blo gros kyis phul brtser dgongs bzhes// ngan song 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun bsal nas// mkha' spyod rig 'dzin grub pas sangs rgyas kyi// zhing mang bgrod cing chos la dbang 'byor nas// mthar thug rgyal ba'i sku gsum brnyes par mdzod// ces pa a dran kun dga' blo gros kyis ral gri rin chen dpal sa skya'i bse 'bag gi spyan gzigs su phul ba'i kha byang du/ ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa sarbār+tha sid+dhir+bha wa tu// ༈ //'khor 'das dregs pa ma mo kun gyi gtso// dpal ldan 'dod khams lha mo re wa tī// dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa da tshur gson// bstan don lhag bsam dkar ba'i sbyin bdag gis// khyed cag thugs dang 'gal ba'i las gang bgyis// mchod bstod gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshags na// nyes tshogs sbyangs nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// sbyin bdag 'di la pha rol bsam ngan gyis// kun nas nyer bslangs byad zor mnan gtad sogs// gnod 'tshe'i bar chad phyir bzlog zhi ba dang*// nad med bder 'tsho bsam don kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa 'di'ang dpon a dran kun dga' blo gros kyi rkyen sel 'dod gsol du tshul rin gyis so//

༈ //'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung rin chen snod mchog bskrun las skyes// dge bas bla chen sa skya pa dang e waṃ pa'i// bstan srid dge 'dun bshad sgrub sbyin bdag mnga' 'byor rnams// lhan cig bskal pa'i bar du 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig /ces lhun grub steng gi tshogs zangs 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung zhes bya ba'i zhal byang 'di ni/ ban+de tshul rin gyis smras pa dge'o// ༈ //dkon mchog mchod pa'i sprin chen tshogs zangs bsgrubs pa'i dge /bka' don smra mchog sa skya pa dang e waṃ pa'i// lugs bzang de 'dzin dge 'dun sbyin bdag bcas rnams kyi// chos srid phrin las dpal 'byor yun ring rgyas phyir bsngo// zhes lhun grub steng gi tshogs zangs dkon mchog mchod sprin zhes bya ba'i zhal byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis smras pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
